atoms.b: Alex goes to the orchard to pick apples. She finds a lot of pretty ones. Alex goes home and bakes a pie with her mum. Everyone has a slice of pie!

atoms.b: Hannah, Abe and Roger are at the playground. They play on the climbing frame and swing from their knees. Hannah falls over and hurts her arm. Abe gets her some ice. Nice and cold! When Hannah feels better, they all skate back home.
